identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SCTT11 in Healthy Participants and Participants with Thyroid Eye Disease.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicentre, Randomized, Double-blinded, Placebo-controlled Phase I/II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Efficacy of SCTT11 in Healthy Participants and Participants with Moderate-to-severe Thyroid Eye Disease

primaryOutcomes.measure: The occurrences of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAE), treatment-related TEAE (TRAE), serious adverse events (SAE), and adverse events of special interest (AESI)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day 0 up to 85 days for healthy participants

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proptosis Responder Rate in the study eye
primaryOutcomes.description: Proptosis Responder Rate in the study eye (i.e., reduction of proptosis of ≥ 2 mm from baseline without a corresponding increase of ≥ 2 mm in the fellow eye\] as measured by exophthalmometer)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in proptosis in the study eye as measured by exophthalmometer
Change from baseline in Clinical Activity Score (CAS)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Diplopia Responder Rate (i.e., reduction in Gorman Subjective Diplopia Score of ≥1 from baseline for participants with baseline Gorman Subjective Diplopia Score \>0)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with a CAS of zero or one in the study eye
SCTT11 concentrations in the blood over time
Incidence of anti-drug antibody (ADA) development in SCTT11-treated participants over time
